li.label: slimed
li.description: Something invisible grabbed me and smothered me in warm pink goo. I can still feel it everywhere.

li.label: slime-hugged
li.description: Something unseen wrapped me in a warm, sticky hug and kissed me. Strange. Not... unpleasant.

li.label: embraced by the sweet slime
li.description: It held me so close and so sweetly, and left me a little rounder. I hope it comes back.

li.label: about to burst
li.description: I'm stretched as far as I can go and it's still pumping. Someone tear it off me. Now.

li.label: at the very limit
li.description: Every inch of me is taut and it's still pumping. I know how this ends. I can't make myself want it to stop.

li.label: saw someone burst
li.description: The constrictor kept pumping until they just... burst. I keep hearing the sound.

li.label: saw someone reach their limit
li.description: They swelled until there was nothing left to give, and then past it. I can't stop thinking about how big they got.

li.label: on a fattening commission
li.description: My people sent me here to come home bigger. I mean to deliver.

li.label: made weight
li.description: I've reached the size my people asked for. Everything from here on is a bonus.
